text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Nishino Flower chatting with one of her classmates in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What is it, Nishino? Are you tired? How about a nice pat on the back?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You're always working so hard! ♪ What a good girl!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's not the reaction I was expecting. You usually blush and get all giggly when I do that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-oh… I was just thinking about how nice it is, getting pampered like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower's busy race schedule must be taking a toll on her. Adjusting it might be a good idea.
